about_the_game:
The Maze Wars is an action-packed FPS survival game. Players wake up in a mysterious labyrinth and must fight deadly enemies to find their way out. With multiple levels, advanced weapons, dangerous portals, and unique map designs, each stage becomes more challenging than the last.

Every labyrinth hides new dangers — awareness, speed, and the right strategy are key to survival.

Features:

• Dynamic FPS combat system

• Expanding weapon variety

• Different enemy types (skeletons and more)

• Mysterious portals and transition zones

• Unique labyrinth designs for each level

The demo version includes Level 1 of Chapter 2 from The Maze Wars. Players can experience a brand-new labyrinth design, test two different weapons, fight against new skeleton enemies, and use the updated portal system.

The full version will feature more chapters, new weapon types, additional enemies, and expanded environments with unique designs.

content_descriptors.notes: This demo is a maze-themed escape game where the player defeats skeleton enemies using weapons. The game contains only fantasy violence directed at skeleton creatures. There is no realistic violence, blood, sexual content, drug or alcohol use, self-harm, or any sensitive themes such as sexual assault, non-consensual sex, BDSM, or substance abuse.
